Meteorology

आइसबर्ग बहाव पूर्वानुमान

A prediction of the future movement and position of icebergs in a given maritime area, based on meteorological and oceanographic data, issued to assist in safe navigation.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

A prediction of the future movement and position of icebergs in a given maritime area, based on meteorological and oceanographic data, issued to assist in safe navigation.

Operational example

Ice patrol: Iceberg drift forecast indicates increased risk along shipping lanes from 55°N to 60°N over the next 48 hours.

Localized term

Localized example
